decisions.reason: Its fluid handling technology closely matches the firm's existing mechanical engineering capabilities, so the firm can readily assimilate results and improve it.
Its centrifuge and filtration technology is distant from the firm's core machinery knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve the product.
Precision nozzle manufacturing builds on existing machining and fluid-system know-how, supporting absorptive capacity and retention.
Its mechanical conveyor design is closely related to the firm's machinery expertise, enabling effective learning and improvement.
Magnetic separation requires specialized knowledge outside the firm's core mechanical competencies, reducing absorptive capacity and increasing drop likelihood.
Hinged belt conveyor systems align well with the firm's mechanical and material-handling capabilities, so the firm can learn from early results and keep it.
